name: rizoma
description: CRM maleable multivertical (Peru) — monorepo: NestJS API, Next.js web, workers, shared contracts.

scripts.db:migrate: for m in 001_core_foundation 002_onboarding 003_salud 004_facturacion 005_obras 006_api_keys 007_webhooks 008_usage_counters 009_state_transitions; do psql postgresql://rizoma:rizoma_demo_password@localhost:5432/rizoma -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/migrations/$m.sql || exit 1; done
scripts.db:migrate:test: psql postgresql://rizoma:rizoma_demo_password@localhost:5432/postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS rizoma_t2_test;' -c 'CREATE DATABASE rizoma_t2_test;' && for m in 001_core_foundation 002_onboarding 003_salud 004_facturacion 005_obras 006_api_keys 007_webhooks 008_usage_counters 009_state_transitions; do psql postgresql://rizoma:rizoma_demo_password@localhost:5432/rizoma_t2_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/migrations/$m.sql || exit 1; done
scripts.db:lint: bash db/lint/rls_lint.sh db/migrations/001_core_foundation.sql db/migrations/002_onboarding.sql db/migrations/003_salud.sql db/migrations/004_facturacion.sql db/migrations/005_obras.sql db/migrations/006_api_keys.sql db/migrations/007_webhooks.sql db/migrations/008_usage_counters.sql db/migrations/009_state_transitions.sql
